genomics-genetics.label: Genomics and genetics
genomics-genetics.definition: Genome organization, variation, inheritance and genotype-phenotype relationships; not every operation on sequence files.

transcriptomics.label: Transcriptomics
transcriptomics.definition: RNA abundance, expression, splicing and transcript-level analysis.

epigenomics.label: Epigenomics
epigenomics.definition: Chromatin state, accessibility and DNA modification analyses.

proteomics.label: Proteomics
proteomics.definition: Protein abundance, identification and modification at proteome scale; coordinate analysis alone is structural biology.

structural-biology.label: Structural biology
structural-biology.definition: Molecular structures, conformations and structural dynamics.

metabolomics.label: Metabolomics
metabolomics.definition: Profiles and changes in metabolite measurements; network optimization alone does not establish metabolomics.

systems-biology.label: Systems biology
systems-biology.definition: Mechanistic or network models of interacting biological components.

microbiome.label: Microbiome science
microbiome.definition: Microbial community composition, diversity and function.

evolution.label: Evolutionary biology
evolution.definition: Evolutionary relationships, processes and selection; merely consuming a tree is insufficient.

ecology.label: Ecology
ecology.definition: Organism-environment and community ecological questions; not automatically assigned to every microbiome tutorial.

immunology.label: Immunology
immunology.definition: Immune populations, repertoires or function as an analytical subject; immune sample origin alone remains setting metadata.

neuroscience.label: Neuroscience
neuroscience.definition: Neural signals, organization, activity and function.

bioimage-analysis.label: Bioimage analysis
bioimage-analysis.definition: Image-based biological detection, measurement and characterization; cell biology or ecology needs additional objective/interpretation evidence.

cell-development.label: Cell and developmental biology
cell-development.definition: Cellular organization, differentiation and developmental processes; single-cell resolution alone is insufficient.

biochemistry.label: Biochemistry
biochemistry.definition: Molecular biochemical mechanisms not adequately described by another assigned field.

pharmacology.label: Pharmacology and toxicology
pharmacology.definition: Drug action, dose response and toxicity.

epidemiology.label: Epidemiology
epidemiology.definition: Population-level disease occurrence, exposures and risk.

physiology.label: Physiology and biomechanics
physiology.definition: Organism or organ function and physical mechanics.

clinical-informatics.label: Clinical informatics
clinical-informatics.definition: Clinical records, patient outcomes and health information analysis; disease name or clinical setting alone is insufficient.

airr.label: Immune receptor sequencing
airr.definition: Adaptive immune receptor sequences and derived clonotypes.

rgb-image.label: RGB organism or habitat images
rgb-image.definition: Visible-light organism or habitat images; not automatically microscopy or ecological inference.

scrna.label: Single-cell RNA-seq
scrna.definition: Cell-resolved RNA sequencing measurements or derived expression matrices.

bulk-rna.label: Bulk RNA-seq
bulk-rna.definition: Bulk RNA sequencing measurements or derived expression matrices.

dna-variants.label: Genotypes and sequence variants
dna-variants.definition: Variant/genotype observations; do not infer sequencing versus array assay when unspecified.

metabolite-profile.label: Metabolite profiles
metabolite-profile.definition: Metabolite measurements; do not infer mass spectrometry versus NMR from a table alone.

structure.label: Molecular coordinates
structure.definition: Atomic coordinates; experimental or predicted origin is separate metadata.

trajectory.label: Molecular trajectories
trajectory.definition: Time-indexed molecular coordinates; analysis does not imply running the simulation.

mass-cytometry.label: Mass cytometry
mass-cytometry.definition: Metal-tag cytometry measurements; not inferred solely from tool compatibility.

microscopy.label: Microscopy
microscopy.definition: Biological microscopy images, with optional optical subtype.

community-profile.label: Microbial community profiles
community-profile.definition: Taxon abundance and diversity data; amplicon versus shotgun assay may be unspecified.

electrophysiology.label: Electrophysiology
electrophysiology.definition: Electrical neural recordings or derived spike/unit tables.

mass-spectrometry.label: Mass spectrometry
mass-spectrometry.definition: Mass-spectral measurements; analyte type described separately.

spatial-expression.label: Spatial expression profiling
spatial-expression.definition: Expression observations with spatial registration; retain assay subtype if known.

sequences.label: Biological sequences
sequences.definition: Nucleotide or amino-acid sequences; record molecule subtype and source when known.

ancestral-trees.label: Ancestral trees and tree sequences
ancestral-trees.definition: Ancestral relationships along genomes, including simulated genealogies.

model-data.label: Model specifications and parameters
model-data.definition: Equations, reaction schemes, parameters or initial conditions; a model input, not an experimental assay.

motion-force.label: Motion capture and forces
motion-force.definition: Body-marker trajectories and force measurements for biomechanical inference.

chemical-assay.label: Molecular structures and bioassay outcomes
chemical-assay.definition: Chemical representations paired with activity outcomes; do not infer clinical efficacy.

protein-profile.label: Protein abundance profiles
protein-profile.definition: Derived protein measurements; underlying assay must be separately evidenced.

medical-imaging.label: Medical imaging
medical-imaging.definition: Clinical or preclinical volumetric/radiological images such as MRI and CT; keep microscopy separate.

clinical-records.label: Clinical records and outcomes
clinical-records.definition: Patient characteristics, treatment, follow-up and health outcomes.

data-access.label: Data access
data-access.definition: Retrieve or stream supplied data; retrieval alone does not establish biological inference.

phenotyping.label: Image phenotyping
phenotyping.definition: Extract organism/object shape or color measurements from images.

data-preparation.label: Data preparation
data-preparation.definition: Import, subset, transform and reconcile data identities or representations.

qc.label: Quality assessment and filtering
qc.definition: Compute or inspect quality evidence and optionally filter; record whether metrics are supplied.

normalization.label: Normalization and scaling
normalization.definition: Adjust measurements for scale or technical effects.

feature-selection.label: Feature selection
feature-selection.definition: Select features by a stated criterion.

clustering.label: Clustering
clustering.definition: Infer groups from data; supplied group labels are not sufficient.

marker-testing.label: Marker testing
marker-testing.definition: Compare expression across populations for marker evidence; distinct from replicated treatment inference.

association.label: Association testing
association.definition: Test genotype-phenotype or other stated associations.

group-comparison.label: Group comparison
group-comparison.definition: Compute group differences or tests; record data provenance and method.

annotation.label: Biological annotation
annotation.definition: Assign biological labels or identities using stated evidence.

structural-comparison.label: Structural comparison
structural-comparison.definition: Align structures or measure coordinate differences such as RMSD.

geometry.label: Structural geometry
geometry.definition: Compute molecular angles, contacts or other geometric descriptors.

segmentation.label: Image segmentation
segmentation.definition: Partition image content into objects or regions.

diversity.label: Diversity estimation
diversity.definition: Compute diversity measures for a specified target, such as communities or immune repertoires.

descriptive-analysis.label: Descriptive analysis and visualization
descriptive-analysis.definition: Summarize or visualize biological observations; not automatically inferential statistics.

simulation.label: Simulation or mechanistic modeling
simulation.definition: Run a mechanistic or stochastic model to generate outcomes; model construction and supplied simulations are separate.

prediction.label: Predictive modeling
prediction.definition: Fit or apply a predictive model; consuming predictions alone is insufficient.

integration.label: Data integration
integration.definition: Combine datasets/modalities or correct cross-dataset effects.

alignment.label: Sequence alignment
alignment.definition: Compute sequence/read alignments; supplied alignments alone are insufficient.

quantification.label: Quantification
quantification.definition: Estimate abundances or feature measurements from lower-level observations.

enrichment.label: Enrichment analysis
enrichment.definition: Test or score sets/pathways against an explicit background or ranking.

model-construction.label: Mechanistic model construction
model-construction.definition: Define reactions, equations, parameters or constraints; distinguish specification from running simulations.

inverse-modeling.label: Inverse modeling
inverse-modeling.definition: Infer physical states, forces or parameters from observations with a forward model.

statistical-modeling.label: Statistical model fitting
statistical-modeling.definition: Fit a statistical model for a stated inferential target; fitting alone does not establish predictive validation.

spatial-statistics.label: Spatial statistics
spatial-statistics.definition: Compute spatial organization, autocorrelation or neighborhood statistics; not gene-set enrichment.

feature-extraction.label: Feature and representation extraction
feature-extraction.definition: Compute descriptors or vector representations from inputs, including radiomics and pretrained embeddings; distinct from selecting existing features or training the underlying model.

coverage_rule: Count distinct notebook IDs per content-supported label. Operation implemented/exercise counts stay separate; exclude discussed-only/upstream-supplied. Multi-label totals overlap. Static inspection is not execution validation.
